## Type of change

- [ ] Feature (`feature/*` → `develop`)
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Hotfix (`hotfix/*` → `main`)
- [ ] Release (`release/*` → `main`)
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Refactor or chore

## Related issues

Closes #

## Security impact

- [ ] Adds or changes an MCP tool (its permission category is declared)
- [ ] Touches command execution, file paths, credentials or authentication
- [ ] No security impact

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Tests were added or updated
- [ ] Documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` were updated
- [ ] No credentials or secrets are committed
